title: Premium Billing Accounts — Standard on Holding Several Accounts
content:
**Standard.** A customer may hold several Premium Billing Accounts, so there is no fixed cap on the number of accounts per customer. A new account may be opened only when the customer holds no open account of the same arrangement family. An account is open while its status is pending binder, active, in grace period or lapsed; a closed account is not open.

**Arrangement families**
| Family | Arrangements in the family |
|---|---|
| Individual-market family | Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly, Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly, Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill, Cascade Individual Annual Prepay |
| Exchange family | Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly |
| Group family (per group contract) | for an employer, a group account for the same group contract |

**Which enrollments an arrangement may fund.** Exchange enrollments may be funded only by the Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly arrangement, group enrollments only by a group arrangement of their own group contract, and other individual enrollments only by an individual-market arrangement.

**Basis of the judgement.** Whether the customer already holds an open account of the same family is read from the company's system records of that customer's billing accounts — each account's holder, arrangement and status — as they stand before the new account is opened; for an employer, accounts for different group contracts are separate and do not stand in each other's way.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- A customer holds a Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill account in lapsed status and asks to open Cascade Individual Annual Prepay: the lapsed account is open and of the same family, so the new account may not be opened.
- The same customer's Quarterly Bill account is closed: no open account of the individual-market family remains, so the new account may be opened.
- A customer with an active Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly account opens Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly: different family, so the open individual account does not prevent it.
- An employer holding an active Cascade Group List Bill account for one group contract opens a group account for a different group contract: different contract, so it may be opened.
